description: nx-only gestures between the original's keys: load program 4 into G1 and run it; POWER tapped switches nx's screen off (the original: no key), a key wakes it (no key); START pauses; G1+G2 held locks (no key), START while locked does nothing (no key), START+STOP held unlocks (no key); START resumes; STOP held stops both (the original: POWER tapped). The lines on the wire must be the same.
note: The screen_off checkpoint is informational: nx's screen is dark by design there (backlight off), the original's lit.
